craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 11. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 7. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: The guru should perform the initiation redeeming the dead, bestowing Śiva; that is said by the Supreme Lord in Śrī-Mṛtyuñjaya-Siddha and the rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: gururdīkṣāṃ mṛtoddhārīṃ kurvīta śivadāyinīm śrīmṛtyuñjayasiddhādau taduktaṃ parameśinā
